_comment: Compiled 2026-10-10 by the data worker from research/sources.md (secondary sources). CBIC gazette PDFs were NOT read; see README.md. Chapter titles follow the HS 2022 nomenclature as adopted in the First Schedule to the Customs Tariff Act, 1975; chapter 99 = SAC services. 8-digit lines marked 'Official tariff text NOT verified' carry codes cited by research whose official wording was not available.
